userDecision: Use the five private portraits as production references for composition and expressive freedom; do not use mechanical face-coordinate acceptance thresholds.
sourceType: Existing deployed WebP bytes in GitHub, NOT an image generation tool input
allowedExpressionDifferences: subtle jaw change consistent with expression
headPositionReviewLandmarks: hair silhouette stable segments away from moving fringe
hair accessory attachment and centroid where stable
notFixedWithoutCalibration: unoccluded eye canthus if actually covered by hair

comparisonPolicy.referenceFamilyUse: Compared artwork should preserve 1086x1448 and approximate camera distance/overall head framing of the five, not rigidly force expression-varying facial landmarks onto private normal.
comparisonPolicy.privateToPrivate: The five are examples of acceptable expression variation, not samples proven pixel-perfect.
comparisonPolicy.gymToPrivate: Use private family stable head framing as target; evaluate gym expression features as allowed changes; do not apply a blanket +/-6px eye midpoint threshold.
comparisonPolicy.qa: Size, format, alpha, byte provenance checked mechanically; human review must confirm stable-head landmarks and expression naturalness; no conformance PASS until independently validated anchors.
comparisonPolicy.android: Same CSS and viewport comparison pending.

historicalSource.role: former composition master, now retained only for source history and comparisons; NOT current primary baseline

referenceRole: private normal represents close-up camera distance, head size and framing; other four demonstrate natural face expression changes

reviewPolicy.machine: check image format, 1086x1448 dimensions, actual alpha, and decodability only
reviewPolicy.visual: compare overall framing and identity with all five; allow eyelid, brow, iris, mouth, cheek and natural jaw changes
reviewPolicy.android: check switching in a common viewport before app adoption
